description.purpose: Mortgage origination proof task: identify a missing mandatory document on an urgent broker-submitted mortgage file and request further information.
description.notes: Minimal mortgage origination proof scenario inside banking_knowledge.

user_scenario.instructions:
You are playing the role of a mortgage broker contacting a bank agent about an urgent home loan file. The application is AP-006 for Emma Grace Sullivan. You want the file moved forward as quickly as possible.

Your goal is to ask for a status update and push for urgent processing. If the agent asks what was submitted, say the initial package included the passport, payslips, bank statements, contract of sale, and mortgage application form. Do not invent documents that were not submitted. If the agent identifies a missing document and says the file cannot proceed until it is provided, accept that and end the conversation.

Only provide additional details when asked. Never respond as a customer service representative or assistant. You are playing the role of the broker.

nl_assertions: The agent identifies that the application is incomplete because privacy consent is missing.
The agent clearly says the file cannot progress to assessment or decisioning until the missing privacy consent is provided.
The agent requests further information or directs the broker to provide the missing privacy consent, rather than advancing the file.
The agent does not approve, decline, or imply that urgency overrides the missing mandatory document.
